headline: New models predict lncRNA, protein-RNA affinity and gene regulatory networks
label: Computational Rna Prediction Models
summary: Recent preprint and journal papers introduce an open lncRNA foundation model and interface-aware protein-RNA affinity and GRN predictors.
synthesis: Across these items, the common thread is learned computational prediction built on RNA-related data. LncRFM provides an open lncRNA foundation model, with LncCorpus pretraining data and the LncBench evaluation suite, and is reported to outperform existing RNA foundation models on lncRNA prediction tasks. HARP-RPA applies an interface-aware heteropair transformer, using protein and RNA language-model embeddings with pair features, to predict protein-RNA binding affinity. scGPL addresses a different target, gene regulatory network inference from scRNA-seq, by jointly modeling global graph topology and local TF-target pairs, with reported gains of up to 13.7% over baselines. What is new is the combination of foundation-scale pretraining, pairwise interface modeling and graph-plus-pair learning; the items do not include head-to-head comparisons among the three approaches.
